full_judgment: 6. In view of the above submission of the learned Advocate for both the sides, I have perused the judgment and decree passed by the learned Trial Court and also Judgment and decree of reversal passed by the learned appellate court. Learned Deputy Attorney-General submits that in view of section 13 of the অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যর্পণ আইন, ২০০১ the suit has been abated. In this regard the Tribunal has been constituted wherein the plaintiff could have sought remedy. In reply to this submission of the learned Deputy Attorney-General, learned Advocate Mr Sikder Mahmudur Razi for the petitioner submits that section 13 of the অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যর্পণ আইন, ২০০১ will not be applicable in this particular suit as because section 13 of the অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যর্পণ আইন, ২০০১ deals with those properties which were enlisted as returnable vested property by publishing in the official gazette of the government. But with regard to the land of the instant suit, no such Gazette notification was officially published by the government and in that view of the matter section 13 of the অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যর্পণ আইন, ২০০১ will not be applicable for this suit.
